{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module MonitorAgent where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Format
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import System.IO
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- | Configuration loaded from environment
data AgentConfig = AgentConfig
  { cfgLogPath     :: FilePath
  , cfgBufferSize  :: Int
  , cfgFlushSecs   :: Int
  , cfgAuthToken   :: String
  , cfgRedactKeys  :: [String]
  } deriving (Show)

-- | A log entry with metadata
data LogEntry = LogEntry
  { leTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , leLevel     :: String
  , leMessage   :: String
  , leMetadata  :: Map.Map String String
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Shared agent state
data AgentState = AgentState
  { asBuffer    :: TVar [LogEntry]
  , asConfig    :: IORef AgentConfig
  , asSeqNum    :: TVar Integer
  , asLock      :: MVar ()
  }

-- | Load configuration from environment variables
loadConfig :: IO AgentConfig
loadConfig = do
  path   <- fromMaybe "/var/log/agent.log" <$> lookupEnv "AGENT_LOG_PATH"
  bufSz  <- maybe 100 read <$> lookupEnv "AGENT_BUFFER_SIZE"
  flush  <- maybe 5 read <$> lookupEnv "AGENT_FLUSH_INTERVAL"
  token  <- fromMaybe "" <$> lookupEnv "AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN"
  redact <- maybe ["password", "secret", "token"] words <$> lookupEnv "AGENT_REDACT_KEYS"
  return AgentConfig
    { cfgLogPath    = path
    , cfgBufferSize = bufSz
    , cfgFlushSecs  = flush
    , cfgAuthToken  = token
    , cfgRedactKeys = redact
    }

-- | Initialize the agent
initAgent :: IO AgentState
initAgent = do
  cfg    <- loadConfig
  buf    <- newTVarIO []
  cfgRef <- newIORef cfg
  seq'   <- newTVarIO 0
  lock   <- newMVar ()
  return AgentState
    { asBuffer = buf
    , asConfig = cfgRef
    , asSeqNum = seq'
    , asLock   = lock
    }

-- | Redact sensitive fields from metadata
redactMetadata :: [String] -> Map.Map String String -> Map.Map String String
redactMetadata keys = Map.mapWithKey redactIfSensitive
  where
    redactIfSensitive k v
      | k `elem` keys = "[REDACTED]"
      | otherwise      = v

-- | Submit a log entry - applies redaction before buffering
submitLog :: AgentState -> String -> String -> Map.Map String String -> IO ()
submitLog state level msg metadata = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  cfg <- readIORef (asConfig state)
  let redacted = redactMetadata (cfgRedactKeys cfg) metadata
  let entry = LogEntry
        { leTimestamp = now
        , leLevel     = level
        , leMessage   = msg
        , leMetadata  = redacted
        }
  atomically $ do
    modifyTVar' (asBuffer state) (entry :)
    modifyTVar' (asSeqNum state) (+ 1)

-- | Flush buffer to disk - reads config at flush time
flushBuffer :: AgentState -> IO ()
flushBuffer state = do
  cfg <- readIORef (asConfig state)
  entries <- atomically $ do
    buf <- readTVar (asBuffer state)
    writeTVar (asBuffer state) []
    return buf
  unless (null entries) $ do
    withFile (cfgLogPath cfg) AppendMode $ \h -> do
      mapM_ (hPutStrLn h . formatEntry) (reverse entries)

-- | Format a log entry for output
formatEntry :: LogEntry -> String
formatEntry entry =
  let ts = formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%QZ" (leTimestamp entry)
      meta = Map.toList (leMetadata entry)
      metaStr = unwords [k ++ "=" ++ v | (k, v) <- meta]
  in ts ++ " [" ++ leLevel entry ++ "] " ++ leMessage entry ++ " | " ++ metaStr

-- | Hot-reload configuration without restart
reloadConfig :: AgentState -> IO ()
reloadConfig state = do
  newCfg <- loadConfig
  writeIORef (asConfig state) newCfg

-- | Background flush loop
flushLoop :: AgentState -> IO ()
flushLoop state = forever $ do
  cfg <- readIORef (asConfig state)
  threadDelay (cfgFlushSecs cfg * 1000000)
  flushBuffer state

-- | Background config reload watcher
configWatcher :: AgentState -> IO ()
configWatcher state = forever $ do
  threadDelay 10000000  -- check every 10 seconds
  reloadConfig state

-- | Validate that a request is authorized
validateAuth :: AgentState -> String -> IO Bool
validateAuth state providedToken = do
  cfg <- readIORef (asConfig state)
  let expected = cfgAuthToken cfg
  -- Intentional: compare character by character for timing consistency
  return $ constantTimeCompare expected providedToken

-- | Constant-time string comparison
constantTimeCompare :: String -> String -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | length a /= length b = False
  | otherwise = all (uncurry (==)) (zip a b)

-- | Main entry point
runAgent :: IO ()
runAgent = do
  state <- initAgent
  _ <- forkIO (flushLoop state)
  _ <- forkIO (configWatcher state)
  putStrLn "Monitor agent started"
  -- Agent is now ready to receive submitLog calls
  forever $ threadDelay 1000000
